turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Start there.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for thanks. Who decided to enter that zero, and was Owen heard before you did it?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a machine's guess, and the company that makes it says in writing it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student; I have their guide in my bag. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. So what else do you have, Hale, or was that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Okay. Fourteen of those tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, so if that's your case, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Procedure 4.2 says you contact me before any mark goes in, and my phone never rang. So you decided first and planned to ask questions later.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a software score and a skipped procedure. I'm writing that down. Withdraw the zero today, Hale, or show me something with Owen's name on it.
